verdict: FALSIFIED (scope-(a) correction of R9's interpretation). The deuteron ladder (fixed light cluster = deuteron, A_light=2) has Model-G miss [-0.090, 2.807, 5.818, 1.632] at k=[1,2,3,4], a strict interior maximum at k=3 (14N) — NOT at k=2 (10B) as the resonance-at-k=A_light reading predicted. The peak sits at the SAME k=3 as the triton ladder (A_light=3), and the neutron ladder (A_light=1) ALSO peaks at k=3 (13C), where the resonance shape is degenerate (no positive peak) — three ladders, three A_light values (1,2,3), one peak location k=3. The peak therefore does NOT track A_light; it is a FIXED-k=3 effect: the 3-alpha Brunnian onset (the k>=3 alpha.alpha gate turn-on of Model G). The 'resonance at k=A_light' INTERPRETATION from R9 is refuted. What A_light DOES control is the peak AMPLITUDE (k=3 heights ~2.8/5.8/8.0 MeV for A_light=1/2/3), not its location. R9's structural prunes P1 (additive non-negative cone) and P2 (monotone-saturating 1-prod class) are NOT under test and STAND — the interior-maximum invariant they rest on holds (indeed is strengthened) on all three ladders. This is a falsification test, not a fit: b and the ledger reused from committed witnesses; only the fresh AME deficits read. Nothing wired; no tier change.
